title: Field logbook: tracing + cost telemetry adjustments — 2026-08-27
body:
Purpose

Quick working notes from this week’s hands-on: patching trace sampling, measuring token-level cost telemetry, and iterating a lightweight dashboard for low-latency regressions. This is a field logbook — rough, actionable, and intended to capture what we tried, why, and what to do next.

Attendees (ad-hoc):
- Asha (owner)
- Marcus
- Riley
- Lena
- Devon (observability infra on-call)

High-level summary / decisions
- We saw a 27% increase in inferred per-token cost signal in the past 10 days; root cause appears correlated with increased long-tail traces from routed fallback model variants.
- Short-term change: increase trace sampling rate for routes flagged as "dedicated-fallback" from 5% -> 20% for 48 hours to gather KV-prefetch patterns (Riley -> deploy change, JIRA-OBS-987).
- Medium-term: prototype a per-route token-cost attribution breakdown on the latency dashboard. Scope: top-20 routes by qps (Marcus + Lena).
- We will not change prefix/KV caching policy this week; instead capture higher-fidelity cache-miss traces to decide.

Standup snippets (daily captures)
- Mon 2026-08-24: Quick triage — billing anomaly flagged by finance, flagged tokens/time buckets around 03:00–06:00 PT. Started a correlation pass between trace tail (p99.9) and cost spikes.
- Tue 2026-08-25: Deployed increased tracing for fallback routes in test namespace. Observed higher KV cache-miss rates in those paths, likely due to stale model-variant code paths creating new cache keys.
- Wed 2026-08-26: Ran CSV export of spans filtered by tag:route=fallback and tag:kv.miss=true. Roughly 15% of fallback requests show multiple KV misses within first 20 tokens.
- Thu 2026-08-27: Synthesis meeting + decisions (see above).

What we measured (snapshot) — raw numbers (preliminary)
- Baseline token cost signal (system-wide median): 0.0024 USD/token (7-day moving avg).
- Observability-inferred spike window (2026-08-18 -> 2026-08-26): sample median 0.0031 USD/token for affected routes (+29%).
- Trace volume change after increased sampling: total spans/day +38% in test namespace; index storage growth ~+0.6GB/day (estimate).
- KV miss rate in fallback routes: 0.15 -> 0.32 after code rollout in variant-17 (confirmed by span tags).

Action items (owners, due dates)
- Riley: Roll out sampling bump to canary production for fallback routes (20% for 48h). Monitor index growth and cut-over plan if storage threshold exceeded. Due: 2026-08-28. JIRA-OBS-987.
- Marcus: Add per-route token-cost panels to the latency dashboard prototype. Data sources: token-cost metric (experiment stream) + per-route qps. Due: 2026-09-03.
- Lena: Produce CSV of span-level KV miss chains (start->first-kv-miss->subsequent misses) for variant-17 and variant-14 across 7-day window. Due: 2026-08-30.
- Devon: Add automated alert rule: if fallback-route token-cost > system median *1.25 for 30m, page ops-runbook on-call. Due: 2026-08-30.
- Asha: Draft short explainer for finance + product on what trace-derived token-cost means and limitations. Due: 2026-09-01.

Experiment notes (design + safety)
- Goal: determine whether increased per-token cost is driven by extra tokens emitted (longer completions) or repeated expensive compute per token (KV miss + rewarm).
- Metric DOs: capture both tokens_out and compute_ns/token (approximated via GPU-sched time) per trace. Add span tag kv.miss_count and cold_kv=true/false.
- Safety: sampling bump limited by storage and indexing cost. If index growth rate > +1.2GB/day, immediately revert sampling to 5% and post-mortem. Alert to #observability-ops.

Sample queries / quick reproduction steps
- Span filter for suspicious traces: service:inference and tag:route:fallback and tag:kv.miss=true and duration>200ms.
- Grafana ephemeral query for per-route token cost (proto):
  - sum(rate(token_cost_total[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(tokens_out[5m])) by (route)
- Elastic-like quick export (dev box): curl -XPOST "$ELASTIC/_search" -d '{\n  "query": {\n    "bool": {\n      "must": [\n        {"term": {"tags.route": "fallback"}},\n        {"term": {"tags.kv.miss": true}},\n        {"range": {"@timestamp": {"gte": "now-7d"}}}\n      ]\n    }\n  },\n  "size": 10000\n}' | jq '.hits.hits[] | {id: ._id, duration: ._source.duration, kv_miss_count: ._source.tags.kv_miss_count, tokens: ._source.metrics.tokens_out}' > fallback-span-sample.json

Runbook / quick operational checklist (for on-call)
- If token-cost alert fires:
  1) Confirm scope (routes impacted) via per-route panel.
  2) Check recent deploys for model-variant rollouts. Tag deployments in PRs with 'obs-impact' for easier correlation.
  3) If fallback routes included, enable targeted higher sampling for 1h to capture hot traces (use feature flag).
  4) If index storage trending > +1GB/day, drop sample rate to 5% and escalate to infra-storage.

Debate notes / unresolved questions
- How representative is span-derived token-cost when function calling / structured outputs are enabled? (we may be double-counting token_cost in client-side vs server-side instrumentation). Need a short audit (Asha).
- Should we attribute cost to route or to model-variant? Early signals point to variant-17 code path being the origin, but routing layer aggregates per-route which blurs variant-level differences. Proposal: add model_variant label to spans (Marcus) — small schema change, but needs backward compatibility check.

Backlog ideas (non-blocking)
- Heatmap of token-cost vs sequence-length bucket (quick visual) to detect whether longer completions are main driver.
- Synthetic runners that replay 1k requests with configured KV state to measure cold starts.
- Cost-estimator sidecar that attaches to sampling traces and outputs per-request estimated cost in USD to a debug log (opt-in).

Notes to self (informal)
- Watch storage compaction policy — if we keep raising sampling for diagnosis we will need an expunge script for old ephemeral indexes.
- Remind product that per-route cost differences are noisy — include confidence intervals in dashboard.
- Make sure finance gets the explainer before next billing sync (they asked today).

Next sync: 2026-09-01, 10:30 PT (30m) — agenda: review canary sampling data, dashboard prototype, decide on model_variant span tag rollout.

End of field logbook entry.
